manual.assorteddecor.chapter.hanging.cal: A calendar on the wall keeps count of the days you have been in the world.
manual.assorteddecor.chapter.hanging.clo: A wall clock shows the time of day.
manual.assorteddecor.chapter.hanging.fra: Right click a hung frame with a dye and it takes that color, so a wall can be framed in one shade or in several.

Frames add depth where wallpaper adds pattern, in wood or iron, and right click to cycle through their patterns the same way.

A frame is sturdier than wallpaper: take the block out from behind it and it stays where it is.
manual.assorteddecor.chapter.hanging.neo: A neon sign works like an ordinary sign, except colored text glows and there is a proper editor for getting the layout right. Three backgrounds to choose from.
manual.assorteddecor.chapter.hanging.wal:
Wallpaper covers a wall without taking up the block. Once it is up, right click to cycle through the designs, and right click with a dye to color it.

Wallpaper next to wallpaper tries to match its neighbours, so a whole wall lines up on its own.
manual.assorteddecor.description: Blocks that take on the look of other blocks, plus furniture, lights, decorations, wall art, roads and more.
manual.assorteddecor.title: Assorted Decor
